WAE_CAPABILITIES.title: Web application engineering
WAE_CAPABILITIES.desc: Build customer-facing applications, portals and business applications around real business requirements. From new applications to complex digital platforms, create experiences that are reliable, scalable and built for the people who use them.
WAE_CAPABILITIES.icon: <rect x="3" y="5" width="18" height="14" rx="2"/><path d="M3 9h18"/><circle cx="6" cy="7" r="0.6" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/>

WAE_CAPABILITIES.title: Frontend engineering
WAE_CAPABILITIES.desc: Create responsive, accessible and high-performance interfaces across web applications and digital platforms. Combine modern frontend technologies with thoughtful architecture to make experiences fast, consistent and easy to use.
WAE_CAPABILITIES.icon: <rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="16" rx="2"/><path d="M3 9h18M9 9v11"/>

WAE_CAPABILITIES.title: Backend engineering
WAE_CAPABILITIES.desc: Build the application logic, services, APIs and data foundations behind reliable web applications. Design backend systems that support complex business processes, integrations and changing demands.
WAE_CAPABILITIES.icon: <rect x="4" y="4" width="16" height="6" rx="1.5"/><rect x="4" y="14" width="16" height="6" rx="1.5"/><circle cx="7.5" cy="7" r="0.7" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/><circle cx="7.5" cy="17" r="0.7" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/>

WAE_CAPABILITIES.title: CMS & content platforms
WAE_CAPABILITIES.desc: Build content-driven websites and applications using traditional, headless and composable approaches. Create flexible content architectures that give teams greater control while delivering consistent digital experiences.

WAE_CAPABILITIES.title: Application modernization
WAE_CAPABILITIES.desc: Modernize legacy web applications without unnecessarily starting from scratch. Refactor aging architectures, improve performance, introduce modern technologies and preserve the business capabilities that still matter.

WAE_CAPABILITIES.title: Integration & APIs
WAE_CAPABILITIES.desc: Connect web applications with the systems and services around them. Design APIs and integration layers that allow applications to exchange data and work together across CRM, ERP, commerce, cloud and other business platforms.

WAE_CAPABILITIES.title: Full-stack engineering
WAE_CAPABILITIES.desc: Build complete web applications across the presentation, application and data layers. Combine frontend and backend engineering into cohesive solutions that are easier to develop, maintain and evolve.

WAE_VALUE_ITEMS.title: Fast experiences
WAE_VALUE_ITEMS.desc: Build applications that respond quickly and perform consistently across devices, users and workloads.

WAE_VALUE_ITEMS.title: Scalable architecture
WAE_VALUE_ITEMS.desc: Create application foundations that can support changing traffic, data, functionality and business requirements.

WAE_VALUE_ITEMS.title: Easier evolution
WAE_VALUE_ITEMS.desc: Use modular architectures and maintainable code to make future changes faster and less disruptive.

WAE_VALUE_ITEMS.title: Connected applications
WAE_VALUE_ITEMS.desc: Integrate applications with APIs, business systems, data and third-party services without creating unnecessary complexity.

WAE_VALUE_ITEMS.title: Reliable releases
WAE_VALUE_ITEMS.desc: Build testing, automation, observability and quality into the engineering lifecycle.
